subject: Backwall graphics + interactive kiosk logistics — final approvals needed
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@expo-services.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Backwall graphics + kiosk specs attached — need vendor confirmations

Jordan —

Attaching the latest backwall mockup (v3) and the interactive kiosk spec sheet. We need confirmatory answers on the following by EOD Friday so we can lock signage and crate labels: 

- Hanging points: does the show provide overhead truss points for a fabric backwall at our booth (10x20)? If not, can you confirm max weight for floor-mounted frames?
- Power: 1x 20A dedicated circuit for the kiosk + 1x 120V outlet for the demo laptop. Is there a cost for onsite power drops?
- Network: kiosk will prefer wired DHCP; can you reserve a wired drop or do we need to plan on a hard-wired router?
- Lead capture: we'll bring a tablet but want to confirm where the exhibitor Wi‑Fi landing page goes.

Attachments: backwall_mockup_v3.pdf (art-ready mock), kiosk_specs.xlsx (power/network), shipping_manifest_draft.csv (draft crate labels).

We also want the backwall installed the morning before show open and the kiosk staged by end of install day. Please flag any crew constraints.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@expo-services.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backwall graphics + kiosk specs attached — need vendor confirmations

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the files. Short answers below and a couple of notes: 

- Hanging points: show hall has no overhead rigging for island booths of this size; you will need a self-supported frame or floor mounts. Max floor-mounted frame weight without additional engineering is 250 lbs.
- Power drops: a 20A dedicated circuit is available for $180 (order through the exhibitor portal). We can request onsite electrician for a day-of hookup.
- Network: Wired drops are available but limited; I can reserve one if you confirm by Friday. Wired drop includes a basic switch and runs to nearest floorbox.
- Crew: standard install crew will handle graphics install only. If you want them to set up the kiosk and AV, add a labor hour for 2 techs (approx 4 hours).

I've uploaded the booth floorplan to the exhibitor portal (link: https://expo-services.com/portal/booth-4521). I'll attach the venue's weight/load spec sheet if needed.

Jordan Blake
Expo Services, Account Manager
jordan@expo-services.com
+1 303-555-2076

Quick notes from content/ops: 

- Signage copy: the headline on the backwall needs 1-line reduction to fit the safe zone (see comments on backwall_mockup_v3.pdf). Vanessa, can you confirm final headline by Tuesday so studio can export?
- Kiosk UX: we will run a short demo video loop + a signup form. If the kiosk is wired and on the Red network we can POST leads to HubSpot in real-time; if not, plan B is local CSV that ops will upload nightly.
- Shipping: for crate labeling, please adopt this naming convention: REDWOOD_BOOTH_4521_CRATE_01 (add actual crate counts after final pack). I added these labels to shipping_manifest_draft.csv.

Jordan — please reserve the wired drop for now; we can cancel if it doesn't make sense after Vanessa confirms. Also confirm if the crew can handle the kiosk power routing into the floorbox on install day.

Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Ops
tessa@redwood.com

Vanessa/Tessa —

Wired drop reserved for Booth 4521 (order #WD-4521-08). Estimated install window: Tue 16 Aug 08:00–12:00.

Crew update: graphics install crew confirmed for Mon 16 Aug PM; AV/kiosk techs can be scheduled for Tue morning, 2 techs for 4 hours (labor estimate attached on portal).

Shipping window for crates: delivery to dock accepted Aug 14–15 (preferred). Please mark crates with the naming convention Tessa suggested. If you want us to receive & store crates overnight, add handling service (I'll add pricing to the portal).

Jordan

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@expo-services.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backwall graphics + kiosk specs attached — ADA and neighbor clearance

Couple of operational asks before we finalize: 

- ADA clearance: The backwall must not obstruct the 36" aisle clearance. Vanessa, please confirm the final print bleed doesn't extend into the walk aisle; Jordan, can you confirm booth placement relative to main aisle?
- Neighboring booth: Booth to our right (Booth 4522) requested that we not place any freestanding signage within 4 ft of their space. Please confirm we can still place the kiosk at the front-right corner without violating this.
- Fallback plan: if the wired drop fails onsite, plan to operate kiosk with LTE hotspot and have a pre-configured CSV export from the kiosk app. Tessa, can the demo laptop be pre-loaded with the lead-upload script?

If all good, I'll sign off on graphics and shipping.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Platform Partnerships (ops lead for this show)
rishi@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@expo-services.com>

Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: FINAL: Approve backwall art + confirm crate delivery window (Aug 14–15)

Jordan/Alice —

Thanks for the confirmations. Final approvals from Redwood: 

- Backwall: approved as-is with minor headline trim (studio to export by 2026-08-17 10:00 PDT). Please ensure the print keeps 36" aisle clearance.
- Kiosk: wired drop reserved (order #WD-4521-08). If wired fails, switch to LTE hotspot — ops to bring pre-programmed backup.
- Power: please proceed with ordering the 20A circuit and electrician labor for Tue morning.
- Shipping: crates will be delivered Aug 14–15 to the dock; please receive and hold — add overnight storage to the invoice. Crate labels use naming scheme REDWOOD_BOOTH_4521_CRATE_01..03 (final counts attached in shipping_manifest_draft.csv).

Attachments: backwall_mockup_v3.pdf (approved), kiosk_specs.xlsx, shipping_manifest_draft.csv; please confirm once crew and electrician are scheduled on your side.

If everything looks good I'll notify the rest of the field team and ship final assets to your upload link.

Appreciate it — see you onsite.

Vanessa Ortiz
